body_md:
## Investment summary
Alphabet has two growth engines. Search still grows double digits, and Cloud doubled to a $123B annualized revenue run rate with 36% segment margins. The market is focused on the bill: capex jumped to $51.4B in Q3, free cash flow turned negative, and Alphabet is now raising equity and debt instead of buying back stock. Shares are about 31% below their high and trade near 19x consensus FY2027 EPS.

Our view: the business is executing, but returns on the AI build-out won't be visible until TPU deliveries and Cloud backlog convert to cash during 2027. We set a base fair value of $322 (24x our FY2027E EPS of $13.40, which is below consensus because we assume heavier depreciation), with a $268–$388 range.

## What would change our view
Upside: the 2027 capex guide (expected Feb 3, 2027) comes with a credible path back to positive FCF, Search holds at 10%+ growth, and the D.C. Circuit leaves remedies unchanged.
Downside: Search growth drops below about 5%, Cloud margins compress sharply as hardware mix rises, or the appeal brings a default-payment ban or Chrome divestiture.
